Design rule 1: file cabinet first

The default page should show existing files and the upload zone. Template catalog, policy, and controls are secondary context.

Design rule 2: plane is visible

Every file shows whether it updates enterprise context, attaches to a Source event, or extends the pattern layer.

Design rule 3: safe evidence still works

Masked values keep useful structure. Scrambled values are allowed when structure is unnecessary.
